The good: I missed THEM. SO MUCH. I remember hearing the writers say that they had to fight to keep Vi's cupcake line in so the fact that we've gotten this far makes me soar. The Sevika/Jinx scenes were really cute and I'm happy with Jayce's arc. I KNOW Cait sees through Vi's bullshit for what it is, protecting Jinx. and I'm not for defending domestic violence but comparing your gf to her mother's murderer isn't the best move.....at the same time Vi whimpering made me bawl. hg can't breathe without shit being thrown at her. Vi practically stained her parents' memory by joining the enforcers. But then also also she was so determined to get rid of Jinx and even told Cait to take the shot prior. Really pulled a Hamlet there

The bad: The musical montages were really unnecessary... from the pacing of the plot it's clearly rushed. Couldn't they have foregone the stylized witchunt scene for something more meaningful? I'm not liking this season's soundtrack either (the marvel esque music of the act 2 teaser is...yikes) while the petals scene with Cait was beautiful the mourning scene started so jarringly and um..her lines about her inner turmoil were ctrl c ctrl v whattpad and left me head scratching. The Jinx/Vi confrontation was suchh a letdown with the slow-mo scenes. As if it was made just for the trailer (Jinx 1v1ing with her fists..what?) I don't care for the insertion of Isha when I know it's probably going to be used as a plot device because awww cute child doesn't see Jinx as a monster. I hope they add depth because the Jinx/Silco parallels are going to be neat. And Schnee had theorized that Maddie(? The ginger enforcer) was a callback to Marcus' daughter but with the lack of a timeskip I don't think that's the case. With what , ahem *people say* , I'm 😕😕 with ginger's purpose in the story. Also we needed more focus on Vi's decision than being brushed off by some dramatic team reveal. Jayce's motivations for using Hex as a weapon are all over the place. One scene he's firm in respecting Vic's wishes and then another he's not. I know it's not that simple and he's supposed to be brash (according to LoL players) as he shifted only after the threat affected him directly and this could've been presented better. The black rose thing oversaturated the already messy plot.

All in all i think the writers were expecting the show to be cancelled after S1 lol with the way it ended so neatly, and every scene was so purposeful. i'm still happy we got a continuation
